Taxa shared between groups, and the core microbiome.

Source: R/taxa_shared.r
taxa_shared.Rd

Lists which taxa are found in which groups of samples. With a prevalence cut-off (prev) the taxa listed for a group are its core microbiome. taxa_upset() plots the result.

Usage

taxa_shared(
  biom,
  stat.by = NULL,
  rank = -1,
  detect = 0,
  prev = 0,
  unc = "singly",
  lineage = FALSE
)

Arguments

biom

An rbiom object, or any value accepted by as_rbiom().

stat.by

Dataset field with the groups to compare. Must be categorical. Samples with NA in this field are left out. NULL puts every sample in a single group named "All", which gives a plain core microbiome list. Default: NULL

rank

Which taxa rank to use. E.g. "Phylum", "Genus", ".otu", etc. An integer can also be given, where 1 is the highest rank, 2 is the second highest, -1 is the lowest rank, -2 is the second lowest, and 0 is the OTU "rank". Run biom$ranks to see all options for a given rbiom object. Default: -1.

detect

Detection threshold. A taxon is present in a sample when its relative abundance there is greater than detect, a fraction from 0 to 1 (0.001 is 0.1%). The default counts any observation. Default: 0

prev

Prevalence threshold. A taxon belongs to a group when it is present in at least this fraction of the group's samples, and in at least one of them. So 0 needs a single sample, 0.9 needs 90% of the group's samples, and 1 needs all of them. Default: 0

unc

How to handle unclassified, uncultured, and similarly ambiguous taxa names. Options are:

"singly" -

Replaces them with the OTU name.

"grouped" -

Replaces them with a higher rank's name.

"drop" -

Excludes them from the result.

"asis" -

To not check/modify any taxa names.

Abbreviations are allowed. Default: "singly"

lineage

Include all ranks in the name of the taxa. For instance, setting to TRUE will produce Bacteria; Actinobacteria; Coriobacteriia; Coriobacteriales. Otherwise the taxa name will simply be Coriobacteriales. You want to set this to TRUE when unc = "asis" and you have taxa names (such as Incertae_Sedis) that map to multiple higher level ranks. Default: FALSE

Value

A tibble data frame with one row per taxon that belongs to at least one group, and columns:

.taxa

The taxon's name.

One column per group

Named after the levels of stat.by, in level order: TRUE when the taxon belongs to that group.

.n_groups

How many groups the taxon belongs to.

.set

The combination of groups the taxon belongs to, e.g. "Saliva & Stool".

.prev.<group>

One column per group: the fraction of the group's samples in which the taxon is present.

Rows are sorted by .set (the largest set first), then by name.

The number of taxa in each set is attached as attr(, "sets"): a tibble with .set, .n (taxa belonging to exactly that combination of groups), .n_groups, and one logical column per group, sorted from the largest set to the smallest.

The result carries $code: the R code that regenerates it, including the steps that produced biom.

Details

Whether a rare taxon is observed in a sample depends on how deeply the sample was sequenced, so give this function rarefied counts (see rarefy()).

See also

Other taxa_abundance: sample_sums(), taxa_boxplot(), taxa_clusters(), taxa_corrplot(), taxa_da(), taxa_forest(), taxa_heatmap(), taxa_stacked(), taxa_stats(), taxa_sums(), taxa_table(), taxa_top(), taxa_upset()

Examples

    library(rbiom)

    biom <- rarefy(hmp50)

    # Genera found at each body site.
    shared <- taxa_shared(biom, stat.by = "Body Site")
    shared
#> # A tibble: 219 × 13
#>    .taxa    `Anterior nares` `Buccal mucosa` `Mid vagina` Saliva Stool .n_groups
#>    <fct>    <lgl>            <lgl>           <lgl>        <lgl>  <lgl>     <int>
#>  1 Acidami… FALSE            FALSE           FALSE        FALSE  TRUE          1
#>  2 Akkerma… FALSE            FALSE           FALSE        FALSE  TRUE          1
#>  3 Bilophi… FALSE            FALSE           FALSE        FALSE  TRUE          1
#>  4 Blautia  FALSE            FALSE           FALSE        FALSE  TRUE          1
#>  5 Butyric… FALSE            FALSE           FALSE        FALSE  TRUE          1
#>  6 Butyriv… FALSE            FALSE           FALSE        FALSE  TRUE          1
#>  7 Candida… FALSE            FALSE           FALSE        FALSE  TRUE          1
#>  8 Clostri… FALSE            FALSE           FALSE        FALSE  TRUE          1
#>  9 Collins… FALSE            FALSE           FALSE        FALSE  TRUE          1
#> 10 Coproba… FALSE            FALSE           FALSE        FALSE  TRUE          1
#> # ℹ 209 more rows
#> # ℹ 6 more variables: .set <fct>, `.prev.Anterior nares` <dbl>,
#> #   `.prev.Buccal mucosa` <dbl>, `.prev.Mid vagina` <dbl>, .prev.Saliva <dbl>,
#> #   .prev.Stool <dbl>

    attr(shared, "sets")
#> # A tibble: 24 × 8
#>    .set        .n .n_groups `Anterior nares` `Buccal mucosa` `Mid vagina` Saliva
#>    <fct>    <int>     <int> <lgl>            <lgl>           <lgl>        <lgl> 
#>  1 Stool       63         1 FALSE            FALSE           FALSE        FALSE 
#>  2 Anterio…    25         1 TRUE             FALSE           FALSE        FALSE 
#>  3 Buccal …    19         2 FALSE            TRUE            FALSE        TRUE  
#>  4 Mid vag…    16         1 FALSE            FALSE           TRUE         FALSE 
#>  5 Saliva      15         1 FALSE            FALSE           FALSE        TRUE  
#>  6 Anterio…    14         3 TRUE             TRUE            FALSE        TRUE  
#>  7 Anterio…    14         2 TRUE             FALSE           FALSE        FALSE 
#>  8 Anterio…     7         5 TRUE             TRUE            TRUE         TRUE  
#>  9 Anterio…     7         4 TRUE             TRUE            TRUE         TRUE  
#> 10 Anterio…     6         2 TRUE             FALSE           TRUE         FALSE 
#> # ℹ 14 more rows
#> # ℹ 1 more variable: Stool <lgl>

    # Core phyla: above 0.1% in at least 90% of a body site's samples.
    taxa_shared(biom, "Body Site", rank = "Phylum", detect = 0.001, prev = 0.9)
#> # A tibble: 5 × 13
#>   .taxa     `Anterior nares` `Buccal mucosa` `Mid vagina` Saliva Stool .n_groups
#>   <fct>     <lgl>            <lgl>           <lgl>        <lgl>  <lgl>     <int>
#> 1 Firmicut… TRUE             TRUE            TRUE         TRUE   TRUE          5
#> 2 Bacteroi… FALSE            TRUE            FALSE        TRUE   TRUE          3
#> 3 Actinoba… TRUE             FALSE           FALSE        TRUE   FALSE         2
#> 4 Proteoba… FALSE            TRUE            FALSE        TRUE   FALSE         2
#> 5 Fusobact… FALSE            FALSE           FALSE        TRUE   FALSE         1
#> # ℹ 6 more variables: .set <fct>, `.prev.Anterior nares` <dbl>,
#> #   `.prev.Buccal mucosa` <dbl>, `.prev.Mid vagina` <dbl>, .prev.Saliva <dbl>,
#> #   .prev.Stool <dbl>

    # Core genera across all samples.
    taxa_shared(biom, prev = 0.5)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 5
#>   .taxa          All   .n_groups .set  .prev.All
#>   <fct>          <lgl>     <int> <fct>     <dbl>
#> 1 Alloprevotella TRUE          1 All       0.510
#> 2 Gemella        TRUE          1 All       0.551
#> 3 Granulicatella TRUE          1 All       0.510
#> 4 Haemophilus    TRUE          1 All       0.551
#> 5 Prevotella     TRUE          1 All       0.592
#> 6 Streptococcus  TRUE          1 All       0.714
